_how_to_add: The videos shown under the pictures on the Gallery page (assets/videos.js), and on My journey for those with "journey". One entry per video, in the order they are listed; the first is in the large player when the page opens. A YouTube video needs "youtube": its id (the part after watch?v= or youtu.be/). A YouTube playlist needs "youtube_playlist": its id (the part after list=); the channel's own uploads are the playlist UU6SyjY2pXoI0UK1tfY7uxcw. A video kept on the site needs "src" (an MP4 in assets/media/) and "poster". Give each a "title", a "kind" (Lesson, Tutorial, Talk, ...), a short "meta" line and, if you know it, its "length" (m:ss). Optional "journey" puts the video on My journey as a card at that stop: the stop's short name as on the timeline ("Amirkabir"), or its year and short name when a name repeats ("2023 NASA"); then run python scripts/build_journey.py. See docs/MAINTAINING.md (Videos).
